displayName.ja: 【バジリスク】 甲賀　弦之介

profile.ja:
甲賀卍谷衆頭領・弾正の孫。
幼い頃から純粋に伊賀と甲賀の和平を望み、そのためにも朧との結婚を望んでいたが、不戦の約定が破られ、配下を率いてこの戦いに臨むことになり、苦悩する。
profile.en: He is the leader of the Koga Manjitsu clan and the grandson of Danjo. Since childhood he has earnestly desired peace between Iga and Koga, even hoping to marry Oboro, but the non-war pact was broken, forcing him to lead his subordinates into battle, tormented by it.

text.ja: 卍谷より参った、甲賀弦之介と申す。遠く離れし地なれど、これもなにかの縁。必要とあらば助太刀いたそう
text.en: I am Koga Gennosuke of Manjitsu, reporting from Manjitsu. Though the land is far away, perhaps fate has brought us together. If needed, I'll lend a hand.

text.ja: 小さき板を見つめながら歩む者たちは何をしておる？　伝書に近しいもの？　ほう……いやはや、この地には面妖なものが多い
text.en: What are those who walk while staring at the little board doing? Something like a messenger? Huh… well, this place is full of strange things.

text.ja: そなたになら教えても問題なかろう。わしの瞳術は害意を持つ者を自滅させる。怯えずとも、そなたからはなんの害意も感じぬ
text.en: I see no problem in teaching you. My eye technique makes those with malicious intent destroy themselves. Even without fear, I sense no ill will from you.

text.ja: 小太郎どのの周囲には女が多いが、あまりうつつを抜かされぬよう。男は女によって、容易く死に至らしめられること、ゆめゆめお忘れなく
text.en: There are many women around Fuuma Kotaro, but don't let your senses be taken. Men can be easily killed by women—never forget that.

text.ja: 無用な争いは、いつの世にもござろう。小太郎どのも、それに苦心しておられような。泰平の世を望むのは、わしも同じじゃ
text.en: Unnecessary conflict has existed in every age. I imagine Fuuma Kotaro also struggles with that. I too wish for a peaceful era.

text.ja: いかがした、小太郎どの。……稽古か？　うむ、よかろう。加減はせぬゆえ、覚悟されよ
text.en: What is it, Kotaro? …Training? Yes, fine. I won't hold back, so be prepared.

text.ja: 異なる地より参ったが、ことごとくが異なっておるわけではござらぬ。月の光の美しさ、わっぱの笑い声などは、地を隔てようと変わらぬものじゃ
text.en: I come from a different land, but not everything is different. The beauty of moonlight, the sound of a child's laugh… those remain unchanged across borders.

text.ja: なにやら小太郎どのも、瞳にまつわるあれこれがあると聞く。……やはり、瞳術を使いしわしと巡り合うのは因縁であったか
text.en: I hear you, Kotaro, also have some matters concerning eyes. …Indeed, meeting someone who uses eye techniques was fate.
